dedupe_keys.name: cerfi tool critical entities resilience failure indication probabilistic indicator based algorithm for the critical point of failure of a critical entity s resilience

description: The CERFI Tool indicates when a critical entity, meaning the owner or operator of critical infrastructure, is likely to fail to stay resilient under a growing threat. The abstract read on 2026-09-28, from a 2024 Safety Science article by David Rehak and co-authors, explains that the tool responds to the EU Critical Entities Resilience Directive 2022/2557, which shifts attention from the resilience of infrastructure elements to that of their operators. Its core is a probabilistic algorithm that relates threat intensity to the protective part of an entity's resilience through indicators that the assessors define themselves, and it returns the critical point at which resilience fails in the prevention and absorption phases. Coverage is a single entity per assessment, with an example from the energy sector; the tool targets energy and transport operators. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): CC-BY-4.0 (article); tool availability not stated. Caveats: results depend on the indicators and weights chosen by the assessors. It supports resilience assessments under the directive, such as testing at what threat level a regional electricity distributor's preparedness fails. No related critical entity resilience indicator record is catalogued. Access is through the provider page linked in this record.
